name: Maximum-Projection Complex
definition: For a nonempty ample class $C\subseteq\{0,1\}^X$, $\operatorname{MP}(C)=\{S\subseteq X:C|_S\text{ is maximum at its own VC dimension}\}$.
codomain: Simplicial complexes on the displayed coordinate set
normalization: Displayed constant coordinates are retained. Every singleton belongs to the complex, and the full simplex occurs exactly when $C$ itself is maximum.
comments: This records maximum projections, not inclusion-maximal shattered supports. It is determined by the ordinary shattered complex for ample inputs and therefore cannot alone obstruct maximum ancestry.
